Package hkust.marketplace.service

Class DealService

java.lang.Object
hkust.marketplace.service.DealService
public class DealService extends Object
Offers, borrow requests and claims (Task 1.5), My Deals actions and auto-return (Task 1.6) and Deal History (Task 1.9). Every state change first re-checks the current status while holding the store lock, so two actions on the same listing at the same time cannot both succeed (e.g. only the first giveaway claim wins).

The seller-side methods (acceptDeal(java.lang.String, java.lang.String), declineDeal(java.lang.String, java.lang.String), counterOffer(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String), counterBorrow(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.time.LocalDateTime, java.time.LocalDateTime)) hold the shared deal rules so the Seller Portal (Task 2) uses the same logic.

  • Method Details

    • makeOffer

      public hkust.marketplace.model.Deal makeOffer(String buyerId, String listingId, String priceText, String message, boolean replaceExisting)
      Makes a price offer on a Sell listing.
      Parameters:
      buyerId - buyer
      listingId - a Live Sell listing
      priceText - offer in HK$, greater than 0 with at most 2 decimal places
      message - optional message to the seller
      replaceExisting - true to replace the buyer's existing Pending/Countered request on this listing
      Returns:
      the new Pending deal
      Throws:
      hkust.marketplace.util.ValidationException - if the price is invalid
      hkust.marketplace.util.MarketplaceException - if the listing is no longer available or a request already exists

    • requestBorrow

      public hkust.marketplace.model.Deal requestBorrow(String buyerId, String listingId, LocalDateTime start, LocalDateTime end, String message, boolean replaceExisting)
      Sends a borrow request with a proposed period on a Lend listing.
      Parameters:
      buyerId - buyer
      listingId - a Live Lend listing
      start - proposed start (not in the past)
      end - proposed end, after the start
      message - optional message to the seller
      replaceExisting - true to replace the buyer's existing Pending/Countered request on this listing
      Returns:
      the new Pending deal
      Throws:
      hkust.marketplace.util.ValidationException - if the period breaks a rule
      hkust.marketplace.util.MarketplaceException - if the listing is no longer available or a request already exists

    • claim

      public hkust.marketplace.model.Deal claim(String buyerId, String listingId)
      Claims a Giveaway listing with one action. The check, the claim and the reservation happen in one atomic step, so when two buyers claim at the same time only the first succeeds.
      Parameters:
      buyerId - buyer
      listingId - a Live Giveaway listing
      Returns:
      the new Pending claim (the listing becomes Reserved)
      Throws:
      hkust.marketplace.util.MarketplaceException - if the listing was already claimed or is otherwise unavailable

      Returns:

    • acceptDeal

      public hkust.marketplace.model.Deal acceptDeal(String sellerId, String dealId)
      Seller accepts a Pending deal. Sell: deal Accepted, listing Reserved. Lend: deal Borrowed, listing Lent for the period. Giveaway: claim Accepted, listing stays Reserved. All other open requests on the listing are declined and their buyers notified.
      Parameters:
      sellerId - seller who owns the listing
      dealId - Pending deal
      Returns:
      the accepted deal
      Throws:
      hkust.marketplace.util.MarketplaceException - if the deal or listing changed meanwhile

    • declineDeal

      public hkust.marketplace.model.Deal declineDeal(String sellerId, String dealId)
      Seller declines a Pending deal. A declined giveaway claim makes the listing Live again.
      Parameters:

      dealId - Pending deal
      Returns:
      the declined deal
      Throws:
      hkust.marketplace.util.MarketplaceException - if the deal is no longer pending

    • markComplete

      public hkust.marketplace.model.Deal markComplete(String buyerId, String dealId)
      Buyer marks an accepted purchase or giveaway as received. The listing becomes Sold or Given and any other open requests are declined. The UI then asks the buyer to rate the seller.

    • processDueDates

      public int processDueDates()
      Auto-return and due-date reminders, run every second by a timer (Tasks 1.6 and 1.8). A Borrowed deal past its due time becomes Auto-returned and the listing Live again (unless removed). One reminder is sent 24 hours before the due time, or halfway through periods shorter than 48 hours.
      Returns:
      number of deals changed (reminders or returns)
